chunks: My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa'd bin Abdullah, from Ya'qoub bin Yazid, from Safwan bin Yahya, from Dhuraih al-Muharibi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The greater pilgrimage is the day of slaughter.

key_terms.يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ: The day of slaughter (10th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of the greater pilgrimage (Hajj al-Akbar) in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Mani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) defining the 'greater pilgrimage' specifically as the Day of Slaughter (10th Dhu al-Hijjah), distinguishing it from the broader Hajj season. This definition underscores the theological weight of the sacrifice and the culmination of Hajj rites in Shia jurisprudence, emphasizing the day's unique status as the peak of spiritual fulfillment and obedience.
